title: Random Tree
statementMd:
Initially, a rooted tree contains only its root, whose depth is 1. A child's depth is 1 greater than its parent's depth. A vertex without children is a leaf.

In each round, every leaf with depth less than k independently chooses one action: it adds one child with probability α, adds two children with probability β, or adds no children with probability 1−α−β.

Choices are independent between vertices and between rounds. All participating leaves act simultaneously, and new vertices can first act in the next round. A leaf that adds no children may still participate in later rounds; vertices of depth k never participate.

Find the expected total number of vertices after n rounds, including the root, modulo M=998 244 353.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases T (1≤T≤10000). Description of the test cases follows.

The first line contains two integers n and k (0≤n≤1018, 1≤k≤106).

The second line contains two numbers α and β (0≤α,β≤1, α+β≤1), each with exactly four digits after the decimal point, representing the probabilities of adding one and two children, respectively.

The sum of k over all test cases does not exceed 106.

## Output

For each test case, output one line containing the answer.

Output the expected total number of vertices after n rounds modulo 998 244 353.

Formally, let M=998 244 353. It can be shown that the answer can be expressed as an irreducible fraction pq, where p and q are integers and q≢0(modM). Output the integer equal to p⋅q−1mod. In other words, output such an integer z that 0 \le z \lt M and z \cdot q \equiv p \pmod{M}.

## Note

In the first test case, \alpha=\beta=1/4 and k=2, so only the root can act. If it adds one or two children in the first round, the final number of vertices is 2 or 3, respectively. If it adds no children in the first round, it tries to grow again in the second round. Thus the expectation is

\frac14\cdot2+\frac14\cdot3+\frac12\left(\frac14\cdot2+\frac14\cdot3+\frac12\cdot1\right)=\frac{17}{8}.

The modular encoding of \frac{17}{8} is 873463811.
